# Official Google Cloud artwork

Downloaded 2026-10-07 from the official library at https://cloud.google.com/icons.
The current overview PDF (May 2026) is https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/google-cloud-product-icons.pdf.

| Local asset | Official archive | Original SVG |
|---|---|---|
| compute-engine.svg | https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/core-products-icons.zip | Compute Engine, four-color core-product SVG |
| networking.svg | https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/category-icons.zip | Networking, two-color category SVG |
| observability.svg | https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/category-icons.zip | Observability, two-color category SVG |

The overview assigns Cloud Load Balancing to Networking and Cloud Monitoring to Observability. These are category icons, not invented product-specific marks; image alternative text identifies them accordingly. Original SVG files are retained unmodified. `cloud-icons.js` embeds their path geometry with the same fills directly in the page; XML headers, editor IDs and style classes are removed or resolved to equivalent fill attributes. This avoids separate asset fetches, clipped image fallback text and class collisions. No artwork is recolored or recreated. Artwork appears only in the optional technology explanation. Datalabs owns the experience; this is not an official Google product or console.
